entries.claim: Sorare is a Paris-based fantasy-sports platform issuing officially licensed digital player cards as NFTs across football, NBA and MLB.
entries.source_ref: Official Sorare product pages / App Store & Google Play listings

entries.claim: The platform runs on StarkWare StarkEx, a STARK-based Validium ZK-rollup with settlement anchored on Ethereum.
entries.source_ref: StarkWare StarkEx public documentation and terminology

entries.claim: StarkEx as used is a Validium: validity proof on-chain, transaction data availability held off-chain by the operator.
Cards are issued in named scarcity tiers (Limited/Rare/Super Rare/Unique) that govern both supply and contest eligibility.
entries.source_ref: Public Sorare product descriptions; tier mint caps NOT asserted

entries.claim: Sorare operates a secondary marketplace carrying a platform fee commonly reported at approximately 5%.
entries.source_ref: Reported public fee schedule / press — requires signed-in in-app verification

entries.claim: Tournament prizes are paid in ETH and rare cards.
Sorare is a private, VC-backed company founded in 2018, widely reported to have raised a ~US$680M round at a ~US$4.3B valuation in 2021.
entries.source_ref: Press coverage of 2021 Series B (valuation/aggregate as reported, not audited)

entries.claim: Sorare's founders are Nicolas Julia (CEO) and Adrien Montfort (CTO).
Sorare has faced gambling-classification scrutiny from France's ANJ and the UK Gambling Commission over paid prize formats.
entries.source_ref: Press reporting on ANJ/UKGC scrutiny — regulator register not inspected here

entries.claim: The mobile client delivery model (native vs React Native vs webview) and auth token internals are not determinable without an artefact.
Sorare's on-chain contract addresses, operator registry, and any TVL/user counts are not stated and require explorer + contract verification.
entries.source_ref: Requires Starknet/Ethereum explorer + contract verification; never to be fabricated

entries.claim: Contest scoring formulas and division thresholds are server-side and derived here as a synthesised model, not observed code.
